description: Approximate, reference-led exterior model of the GTA450-120 automatic horizontal ice-cream packing machine with its long infeed and compact automatic transfer head.
dimensionBasis: Danxiao's exact-model Made-in-China listing publishes 5050 x 960 x 1550 and 1000 kg. The official product page does not publish an exterior envelope. A Bossgoo listing also states 2.2 x 1.05 x 1.8 m, which appears to describe a shorter core-wrapper configuration and conflicts with its own repeated 5050 x 960 x 1550 parameter table. The model uses the complete-line 5.05 x 0.96 x 1.55 m envelope.

references.use: Core wrapper silhouette, two-roll film carriage, operator panel, sealing rollers, end-seal housing, short discharge belt, separate automatic infeed module, and official 30-150 pack/min range.

Published 5050 x 960 x 1550 mm envelope, 1000 kg weight, complete welded skid, long infeed, cabinet proportions, controls, film routing, operator-side and installed views, and 30-180 pack/min variant specification.
Core-wrapper front and reverse views, alternate automatic infeed assemblies, welded base, casters, control-panel revision, film-roll placement, and feeder detail.

High-resolution complete operator-side view plus close-ups of the transfer mechanism, discharge conveyors, and packaged-product path. Product-only images document intended use but do not drive geometry.

recognizableFeatures: Five-meter low stainless infeed feeding a compact cabinet-mounted wrapper.
Sloped upper film carriage with two large roll spindles and several guide rollers.
Blue-framed HMI and button panel on the operator side.
Three exposed longitudinal sealing rollers and a large black adjustment handwheel below the HMI.
Tall end-seal and cutting housing followed by a short white discharge belt.
Welded rectangular floor skid with a mix of leveling feet and small cabinet casters.

confidence.note: The exact-model marketplace listing supplies the overall dimensions.

confidence.area: Core wrapper silhouette and operator controls
confidence.note: Multiple official and marketplace views show the same film carriage, HMI, sealing rollers, cabinet, and end-seal head.
Danxiao shows several swappable infeed and sandwich-forming arrangements. The model uses the compact transfer-head version closest to the official page image.

confidence.area: Far side, internal drives, guards, and film web path
confidence.note: These surfaces are partly hidden or vary by revision. Internal mechanisms remain simple cabinet volume and the film itself is omitted.

usage.purpose: QC floor visualization, machine placement, and wrapper selection
usage.notes: This is an exterior visualization. It is not a fabrication, installation, guarding, maintenance, cleaning-validation, process-control, or safety model. The collected photographs remain in the source asset bundle only.
